entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange launched by Bitcoin.com on 2019-09-02 and rebranded to FMFW.io on 2021-09-29 with customer credentials, 2FA configuration, wallet addresses, and open orders carried through the identity transition.
entity.notes: Bitcoin.com first-party material establishes the exchange launch on 2019-09-02. FMFW.io first-party rebranding material establishes that the Bitcoin.com Exchange identity changed to FMFW.io on 2021-09-29 while existing login credentials, 2FA, wallet addresses, open orders, and custody continuity were preserved. HEI therefore models the Bitcoin.com Exchange brand as a terminal rebranded predecessor rather than as an acquired, merged, or independently shut-down venue. Global is used because the reviewed materials do not establish a sufficiently clear durable exchange operating jurisdiction for the full 2019-2021 identity period.

events.title: Bitcoin.com Exchange launched
events.description: Bitcoin.com announced that its centralized cryptocurrency trading platform at exchange.bitcoin.com was live on 2019-09-02.
events.notes: The date is taken from a contemporaneous first-party Bitcoin.com launch announcement.

events.title: Bitcoin.com Exchange rebranded to FMFW.io
events.description: The exchange changed its public identity and domain to FMFW.io while preserving existing customer credentials, 2FA, wallet addresses, and open orders across the transition.
events.notes: This is a brand/entity identity transition with operational continuity, not evidence of insolvency, acquisition, merger, or loss of customer access.

evidence.title: Bitcoin.com's Premier Cryptocurrency Exchange Is Now Live
evidence.notes: Contemporaneous first-party Bitcoin.com publication states that exchange.bitcoin.com had launched and was live.

evidence.title: Rebranding FAQ
evidence.notes: First-party successor support material states that Bitcoin.com Exchange would become FMFW.io on 2021-09-29 and documents continuity of credentials, 2FA, wallet addresses, open orders, and custody while the exchange and API domains changed.

evidence.title: Bitcoin.com Exchange is becoming FMFW.io
evidence.notes: Successor-operated publication announces the 2021-09-29 rebrand, identifies Bitcoin.com Exchange as the predecessor, and states that users would continue to access the service with the same credentials.
